headline: Ashland falls at Missouri-St. Louis
dek: The loss ended the conference's season six days after Missouri-St. Louis had also shut out Findlay. Ashland had gone 24 days without defeat before the setback, finishing with sixteen wins and eleven goals conceded.
displaced_by: Ashland's loss at Missouri-St. Louis ended the G-MAC season

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Scoring and standing run together: the five programs with 30 goals or more are the five at the top of the table.

wire.line: Ashland ends the G-MAC season with four losses after falling at Missouri-St. Louis.
